title: Zooming Web Pages
drDigitalIntro:
Sometimes text on a page is too small to read — especially bus timetables, pricing tables, and terms and conditions.
• Click the + zoom button (right side of the toolbar) to make everything bigger.
• Click - to zoom back out.
• Ctrl+Plus and Ctrl+Minus do the same thing with your keyboard.
• Zoom does not change the website — it only changes how big it looks on your screen.

playgroundTask.goal: Zoom in to read the bus timetable

steps.say: Go to citytransit.example — type it and press Enter. The timetable is packed with small text.
The bus times are hard to read. Click the + zoom button twice to make them bigger.

drDigitalSuccess: Now the timetable is easy to read! Use the + and - zoom buttons any time text is too small — and use Ctrl+0 to snap back to normal size.
drDigitalHint: Find the zoom control on the right side of the action bar and click the + button twice to reach 150%.
